units.t_s: s since first sample (host receive clock)

method.velocity: central difference of q (rad) on the last row of each identical-timestamp batch, using measured timestamps
method.acceleration: central difference of reconstructed velocity; boundary rows left NaN
method.non_batch_last_rows: derivatives NaN (true sample time unknown); raw values preserved
method.live_qddot: ignored; not trusted as acceleration ground truth

parameters.representative_policy: last row of each identical-timestamp batch

limitations: Times are host receive times, not sample times. Velocity is a candidate; acceleration is exploratory and must not be treated as physical ground truth. Unavailable values are NaN, never 0. Anomalies are not smoothed away unless smoothing_window>1 is requested and recorded here.
